figures.finding: Directors of film and TV are covered by the same national agreement as actors, Medieföretagen and Fackförbundet Scen & Film's Film, TV and Video Filming Agreement of 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2027, whose special provisions for directors leave them outside its working-hours rules.

value.name: Film-, TV- och Videoinspelningsavtalet (Film, Television and Video Filming Agreement)
value.directorsWorkingHours: not covered by the agreement’s working-hours rules or the Working Hours Act

figures.applies: Sweden; directors employed in productions for film, TV and other platforms by Medieföretagen member producers.

sources.said: Valid 01/06/2025 – 31/05/2027 Parties Swedish Media Industries Employer Association Swedish Union for Performing Arts and Film Concerns Artists (actors, singers, dancers, performers), directors, assistant directors, choreographers, set designers, costume designers, … SPECIAL PROVISIONS FOR DIRECTORS Directors are not covered by the collective agreement’s rules on working hours or the Swedish Working Hours Act.

figures.finding: A director of a drama production of at least 15 minutes is owed a basic fee of SEK 2,177 a minute from 1 June 2026 (SEK 2,113 from 1 June 2025), capped at SEK 158,453 for productions over 73 minutes, plus at least SEK 32,082 a month through prep, shoot, post and launch; the basic fee may be cut up to 25% on a first directing job or a series of three or more parts; other productions pay at least SEK 32,082 a month or SEK 1,792 a day.
figures.applies: Sweden; directors under the Film, TV and Video Filming Agreement 2025–2027, clause 37.

sources.said: For drama productions with a length of minimum 15 minutes, the director is paid a basic fee from 01/06/2025 of SEK 2.113 per minute and from 01/06/2026 of SEK 2.177 per minute, and a maximum from 01/06/2025 of SEK 153.837 and from 01/06/2026 of SEK 158.453 for productions in excess of 73 minutes. The above basic fee may be reduced by a maximum of 25 % the first time the director performs directorial duties covered by this Agreement. A reduction of maximum 25 % may also be made for directorial assignments for television series productions comprising at least three parts. … During the production period specified in the contract, the director receives, for their work on the production, minimum remuneration from 01/06/2025 of SEK 31.147 per month and from 01/06/2026 of SEK 32.082 per month. The production work includes preparatory work, filming, post-production and launch. … A director employed for a production other than that specified in sub-clause 1 receives, during the production period agreed in the contract, minimum remuneration from 01/06/2025 of SEK 31.147 per month or SEK 1.740 per day and from 01/06/2026 of SEK 32.082 per month or SEK 1.792 per day.
Regissörer Grundgage för produktion av dramakaraktär på minst 15 min utgår grundgage om 2 177 kr/min, dock högst 158 453 kr för produktion överstigande 73 minuter. Månadslön lägst 32 082 kr/mån.

figures.finding: Where producer and director disagree on the version, the director's version is the one screened in Sweden, provided it keeps to the script, budget and schedule; abroad the producer may alter it (for censorship or length) and the director may then take their name off; the clause does not apply to commissioned productions.

value.directorsCut: director’s version screened in Sweden on disagreement
conditions: follows script, budget, production plan and schedule
imposes no third-party requirements on producer
value.abroad: producer may change; director may remove name
exceptions: case-by-case alternative rules e.g. several directors
value.periods: not fixed: production period specified in the contract

figures.applies: Sweden; Film, TV and Video Filming Agreement 2025–2027, clause 22.

sources.said: If disagreements arise between producer and director about the version in which the production is to be presented, the director’s version will be screened in Sweden. This presupposes that this version does not impose requirements on the producer either from third parties or in the producer’s capacity as the publisher responsible for the production. … In the case of commercialisation abroad, the producer has the right to make changes to the production versions caused by special circumstances such as censorship provisions or adaptation of the length of the film which they consider necessary for the best commercialisation of the production. … The Parties agree that this clause does not apply to commissioned productions.

figures.finding: Directing for SVT falls under SVT's own agreement with Scen & Film; its last published minimums (23 December 2024 to 31 March 2025) are SEK 2,134 a minute for drama of at least 15 minutes (SEK 543 a minute from the 61st minute; SEK 318 for serials of 13 or more parts) plus at least SEK 31,326 a month during prep and production.

value.reductions: up to 25% first time or series of 3+ parts

figures.applies: Sweden; directors engaged by SVT, as published by Scen & Film (latest found 2026-11-01).

figures.finding: Film directors are organised in Sveriges Filmregissörer, a section of Fackförbundet Scen & Film since 2007, which handles directors' copyright and film-agreement questions; membership and fees are Scen & Film's.

value.body: Sveriges Filmregissörer (SFR), section of Fackförbundet Scen & Film
value.fees: see Scen & Film membership (actor research markets/SE)

sources.said: Sveriges Filmregissörer, SFR, bildades som en avdelning inom Scen & Film (då Teaterförbundet) 2007. De film- och mediefrågor inom Scen & Film som påverkar regissörernas arbetssituation hanteras nu av vår organisation, tillexempel upphovsrättsfrågor och filmavtal.
